text:
mia: hey team, trying the python quickstart (https://github.com/redwood-inference/quickstart) and my first request just hangs then fails with a 502. unsure if this is a sample bug or my workspace setup. stack: mac + py3.11, using redwood==0.8.1.

alex: what does the client log show? can you paste the minimal code you ran?

mia: pasted snippet: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
resp = client.generate('hello world')
print(resp)
```
logs: ```2026-03-15 14:02:11 INFO client: connecting to api.redwood.ai
2026-03-15 14:02:12 ERROR http: 502 Bad Gateway on POST /v1/generate
2026-03-15 14:02:12 INFO retry: retrying request (1/3)
2026-03-15 14:02:15 ERROR http: 502 Bad Gateway on POST /v1/generate
2026-03-15 14:02:15 ERROR client: final request failed after retries
```

mia: also noticed the quickstart printed a workspace id in the start logs: ws_abc123 but the web console shows "incomplete setup" with a payment banner. could paygate cause the 502? :facepalm:

alex: hmm 502 from gateway typically means upstream serving issue, not paygate. but if workspace is in a weird state maybe routing falls back weirdly. can you share the workspace id and your org?

mia: ws_abc123, org: acme-staging. last thing I did was follow the sample and clicked "create workspace" when prompted by the CLI.

infra-bot: [deploy] rollout on prod-inference-group completed 2026-03-15T13:58:09Z (no errors).

sam (eng) (joined): if the workspace is missing billing info the control plane sometimes returns a 402 or a friendly onboarding page, but the proxy should surface 402 not 502. could be a transient routing mis-snap where the proxy hit an offline replica.

olivia (support): @mia I checked ws_abc123 — it exists and shows "pending billing verification". There were three quickstart jobs spawned from that workspace in the last 5 minutes. I can manually trigger a repro and see logs if you want. Also can temporarily flip the workspace to "allowlist" so requests aren't blocked.

mia: that would be great, thanks. I can't repro consistently, sometimes first call fails then subsequent calls succeed after ~30s.

devon (docs): two notes: 1) quickstart creates a sample workspace and sometimes the webhook that seeds billing metadata is delayed (race). 2) we should document the CLI warning and show how to check workspace status with `rdwctl workspace status <id>`.

alex: @olivia if you can flip to allowlist, we can determine if paygate was the root cause. also @devon please create a short blurb in the quickstart about the race and the `rdwctl` command.

olivia: done — I set ws_abc123 to allowlisted for 30 minutes. I also attached the service logs: ```upstream: timeout connecting to model-serving-3; kube pod crashloop -> evicted due to OOMKilled at 13:57:58Z``` — looks like a real serving pod flapped.

mia: after allowlist, first call succeeded immediately. so it was a combination: pod flapping caused 502, but paygate would have prevented further retries. good to know. :relieved:

alex: filed infra ticket INF-2026-117 to investigate the OOM root cause and add better error mapping so gateway returns 503/502 clearly and not swallow billing info.

devon: I'll add a doc patch: quickstart FAQ entry and `rdwctl` snippet plus a troubleshooting checklist: check workspace billing state, check `rdwctl workspace status`, inspect client logs for 502 vs 402, and retry policy note.

olivia: filed support follow-up SUP-998: proactively notify users who create a workspace via quickstart and hit a first-call failure with a suggested fix (allowlist toggle) and link to our docs.

mia: thanks everyone — leaving this thread in case others hit the same flake. saved logs to /tmp/quickstart-ws_abc123-logs.txt and ping me if you need more.
